Palette anchors:
- cream #F7F4EF range (warm off-white base)
- forest #1C3A2F range (deep sage authority)

## Files to write (DO NOT plan, just write):

### 1. `src/index.css`
- Keep `@import "tailwindcss";` and `@theme inline {}` block (shadcn bridge — DO NOT REMOVE)
- Replace the `@theme {}` block with full Vela ramps in OKLCH:
  - `--color-cream-{50,100,200,300,400,500,600,700,800,900,950}` (warm off-white scale)
  - `--color-forest-{50..950}` (deep sage scale, 500 ≈ #2E8066, 950 ≈ #1C3A2F)
  - `--color-amber-{50..950}` (warm gold, 500 = #C8963E exact)
  - `--color-ink-{50..950}` (warm neutrals, 900 ≈ #1A1A18)
  - Font tokens: `--font-display` (Fraunces serif), `--font-body` (Inter), `--font-mono` (JetBrains Mono)
  - Radius: `--radius-sm:6px --radius-md:8px --radius-lg:12px --radius-xl:16px --radius-2xl:24px --radius-full:9999px`
  - Shadow tokens with subtle warm tint (slight amber-low-alpha)
  - Motion: `--ease-out:cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1)`, `--ease-spring:cubic-bezier(0.34,1.56,0.64,1)`, `--duration-fast:150ms --duration-base:250ms --duration-slow:400ms`
- Replace `:root {}` (light = cream base): `--background:var(--color-cream-50); --foreground:var(--color-ink-900); --primary:var(--color-forest-800); --primary-foreground:var(--color-cream-50); --accent:var(--color-amber-500); --accent-foreground:var(--color-forest-950); --card:var(--color-cream-100); --border:var(--color-cream-300); --ring:var(--color-forest-600); --muted:var(--color-cream-200); --muted-foreground:var(--color-ink-700); --radius:0.5rem;` etc
- Replace `.dark {}` (dark = forest base): `--background:var(--color-forest-950); --foreground:var(--color-cream-50); --primary:var(--color-amber-400); --primary-foreground:var(--color-forest-950); --card:var(--color-forest-900); --muted:var(--color-forest-800);` etc
- Add `.theme-forest {}` class — mirrors `.dark` block. For wrapping variant 1 (spec) + variant 5 (clinical) roots so they get dark theme on light pages.
- Keep `@layer base { * { @apply border-border; } body { @apply bg-background text-foreground; } }` intact.

### 2. `src/lib/tokens.ts`
TypeScript mirror. NO `any`. Pattern:
```ts
export const colors = {
  cream: { 50: 'var(--color-cream-50)', 100: 'var(--color-cream-100)', /* ...all 11 */ },
  forest: { /* ... */ },
  amber: { /* ... */ },
  ink: { /* ... */ },
} as const;
export const fonts = {
  display: 'var(--font-display)',
  body: 'var(--font-body)',
  mono: 'var(--font-mono)',
} as const;
export const radius = { sm: 'var(--radius-sm)', /* ... */ } as const;
export const motion = {
  ease: { out: 'var(--ease-out)', spring: 'var(--ease-spring)' },
  duration: { fast: 'var(--duration-fast)', base: 'var(--duration-base)', slow: 'var(--duration-slow)' },
} as const;
export type ColorFamily = keyof typeof colors;
export type ColorStep = keyof typeof colors.cream;
```

### 3. `index.html`
Add inside `<head>` BEFORE the existing CSS link:
```html

<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>

```

## After writing
Run `pnpm build` from the project dir. Confirm 0 errors. Report final bundle size.

## Constraints
- DO NOT remove the `@theme inline` shadcn bridge block.
- All tokens via CSS custom properties.
- No hardcoded hex outside the `@theme {}` block.
- Verify shadcn primitives (button, dialog, accordion) still render via `pnpm build` succeeding.

3 files written + build size. Under 100 words. NO PLANNING.
